title: CLA-Data v0.1 Lexicon Entry
description: Schema for a single bilingual dictionary/glossary entry (headword -> one translation sense), distinct from text-record.schema.json (sentence pairs) and monolingual-document.schema.json (whole documents). Multiple senses/synonyms for the same headword are separate records sharing the same headword_fr and sense_index sequence. See docs/cla-data-schema.md.

headword_fr.description: The French headword or expression being defined (e.g. 'abandonner la route').

pos.description: Part-of-speech / grammatical tag as given by the source lexicon (e.g. 'Verbe', 'Nom', 'adj', 'dpn', 'adj/rpn/interrog'). Preserved as-is rather than normalized, since the tag set is source-specific.

text.description: The target-language (fub/ewo/bbj) term or expression for this sense.

sense_index.description: 0-based position of this sense among all senses/synonyms listed for the same headword_fr, in source order.

source_organization.description: Rights holder / institutional partner / dataset citation, when source is institutional_partner or existing_dataset. Null for original.
